user.description: Pick the Vitamix you'd like to add.

manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of the Vitamix.

cancel.name: Cancel program
cancel.description: Unload the current program, like the official app. Refused while the motor runs.

upload_program.name: Upload program
upload_program.description: Upload a custom program of up to four steps; then press start on the blender.

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: List of {power, seconds, ramp} steps. Power is 0-100 %.

container_id.name: Container id
container_id.description: Override the detected container (required on old B-panels).

load_program.name: Load saved program
load_program.description: Experimental: write a slot number to the legacy recipe register.

set_motor_speed.name: Set motor speed
set_motor_speed.description: Experimental: Run the motor at a fixed Variable-speed (0..10).

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: 0..10 on the variable-speed dial. 0 stops the motor.

duration.name: Duration (seconds)
duration.description: u16 seconds; defaults to the run-forever sentinel.

start_motor.name: Start motor
start_motor.description: Experimental: Start the motor; defaults to Variable-5.

stop_motor.name: Stop motor
stop_motor.description: Experimental: write 0 to the legacy recipe register. Not a safety stop.

play_melody.name: Play melody
play_melody.description: Experimental: Sequence (speed, duration) notes for blender music.

gap.name: Gap between notes
gap.description: Optional silence between notes, in seconds.

init.description: The official Vitamix app has no remote start, speed control or stop. These legacy services write registers the app never uses this way and are unverified. Do not rely on Stop motor as a safety stop.
